title: Magnetic Bead Immunoprecipitation with Western Blot Readout

steps.source_text: Prepare the input fraction and antibody-conjugated magnetic beads, including bead washing and antibody binding.
Add the remaining clarified lysate and binding buffer to the antibody-conjugated beads.
Rotate the immunoprecipitation reaction for 2 h at 4 C.
Magnetically separate the reaction and collect the flowthrough while retaining the beads.

steps.section: Wash and Elute the Bead-Bound Protein
steps.source_text: Wash the bead-bound target three times and discard each wash supernatant.

steps.section: Wash and Elute the Bead-Bound Protein
steps.source_text: Denature and elute the bead-bound protein, then magnetically separate the eluate from spent beads.

steps.section: Prepare Input, Flowthrough, and Eluate Samples
steps.source_text: Prepare the input, flowthrough, and eluate samples for electrophoresis.
Load the three samples into assigned lanes and run electrophoresis.
Activate and equilibrate the PVDF membrane, assemble the transfer stack, and transfer proteins.

steps.section: Block, Probe, Wash, and Image the Membrane
steps.source_text: Block, probe, and wash the membrane under the stated conditions.

steps.section: Block, Probe, Wash, and Image the Membrane
steps.source_text: Acquire the fluorescence signals and return a structured Western blot readout.
